messages:
maya: quick heads-up — noticed negative cache credits in amortization export for some multi-model chains.
oliver: can you paste an anonymized row?
maya: chain: c-9, models [micro-v1, base-v2], req:34, resp:110, cached:29, cache_credit:-0.7
sasha: sounds like model-switch + non-linear per-token pricing + rounding issue.
lia: display rounds to 3 decimals, small denominators can flip sign.
oliver: short-term: clamp emitted credits at 0 for UI/exports, keep raw for debugging.
sasha: long-term: compute amortization using chain-level effective token-cost average; add tests for variant switches.
maya: filing issue + hotfix PR (clamp+log). will canary to staging.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy at 03:00 UTC if PR lands.
lia: pinging product/legal re: not changing invoices without signoff.
oliver: thanks — please add repro query and sample rows in the bug.
_meta: generated slack thread about cache amortization edgecase
